description: Compare every route SwapChan found, ranked best-first by net USD received, across aggregators and bridges. Pass extra destination chains in alsoToChainIds to compare same-chain vs cross-chain outcomes side by side. Swap-chan lines up the whole cast. Result includes `display` markdown with chan images and a swapchan.com link: show it to the user. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).

alsoToChainIds.description: Extra destination chains to compare. toToken must then be valid on each (e.g. native token).

items.description: Chain id: 1 Ethereum, 8453 Base, 42161 Arbitrum, 10 Optimism, 137 Polygon, 56 BNB Chain, 43114 Avalanche, 59144 Linea, 534352 Scroll, 792703809 Solana, 8253038 Bitcoin, 728126428 Tron, plus THORChain-only 2000000002 Litecoin, 2000000003 Dogecoin, 2000000145 Bitcoin Cash (either side, THORChain only; sending them needs the native coin and returns an unsigned PSBT on /build or a deposit address from POST /utxo/deposit with the required memo). Non-EVM chains route via Relay, LI.FI and THORChain.

amount.description: Human-readable amount of fromToken to sell, e.g. "1.5". Provide this OR amountBaseUnits.

amountBaseUnits.description: Exact amount in the token's smallest unit (wei). Provide this OR amount.

fromChainId.description: Chain id: 1 Ethereum, 8453 Base, 42161 Arbitrum, 10 Optimism, 137 Polygon, 56 BNB Chain, 43114 Avalanche, 59144 Linea, 534352 Scroll, 792703809 Solana, 8253038 Bitcoin, 728126428 Tron, plus THORChain-only 2000000002 Litecoin, 2000000003 Dogecoin, 2000000145 Bitcoin Cash (either side, THORChain only; sending them needs the native coin and returns an unsigned PSBT on /build or a deposit address from POST /utxo/deposit with the required memo). Non-EVM chains route via Relay, LI.FI and THORChain.

fromToken.description: Token address. partner.description: Optional SwapChan partner/affiliate id (from swapchan.com/partners). Quotes are attributed to it and the swapUrl carries ?ref= so the partner earns 5 bp (half of SwapChan's fee). Agent builders: register via POST https://api.swapchan.com/partners with the operator's payout address.

recipient.description: Address that receives the output on toChainId. Required for real execution when the destination is a different VM (e.g. EVM -> Solana/Bitcoin/Tron); omitted = indicative quote only.

slippageBps.description: Max slippage in basis points (50 = 0.5%). Default 50, cap 300.

toChainId.description: Destination chain id. Same as fromChainId for a same-chain swap; different for a cross-chain route.
